## Problem and resulting behavior

Link the Issue and explain the concrete change and boundaries.

## Verification

List actual commands/results and platform. Identify unrun checks and limitations.
Behavior changes should include a meaningful regression; prose/config changes
should describe their relevant validation.

## Evidence and scope

- [ ] No private source inputs, conversations, credentials or unlicensed attachments.
- [ ] JSON authority, immutable history and artifact safety are preserved.
- [ ] Synthetic examples remain labeled; no scientific review or execution is invented.
- [ ] Relevant docs and path-specific license attribution are consistent.
